<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/work.ts -->
<!--
  Photos in a grid, a masonry of mixed heights, a mosaic with one big tile, a featured picture over a strip of
  thumbnails, or cards with a title and a tag. Static markup: the featured layout's arrows are the page's. Axes:
  layout (grid, masonry, mosaic, featured, cards), captions (show, hide), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Photo, PhotoLabels } from "./photo-gallery.types";

  export type PhotoGalleryProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    photos: Photo[];
    labels: PhotoLabels;
    layout?: "grid" | "masonry" | "mosaic" | "featured" | "cards";
    captions?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import FigureBlock from "../components/figure-block.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    photos,
    labels,
    layout = "grid",
    captions = "show",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: PhotoGalleryProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "featured")}
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="featured">
      <MediaFrame alt={title} />
      <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
        <Stack gap="0">
          <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
            {photos[0]?.title ?? ""}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {tpl(labels.counter, 1, (photos?.length ?? 0))}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Group gap="2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" layout="icon" aria-label={labels.previous}>
            <LucideIcon name="chevron-left" size={16} />
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" layout="icon" aria-label={labels.next}>
            <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" size={16} />
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Group>
      <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-9" data-testid="thumbs">
        {#each photos as p, i (p.id)}
          <MediaFrame alt={p.title} ratio="1/1" class={((i === 0) ? "ring-2 ring-foreground" : "")} />
        {/each}
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  {:else}
    <Box
      class={
        (layout as string) === "masonry" ? "columns-1 gap-4 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3"
        : (layout as string) === "mosaic" ? "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4"
        : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
      }
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each photos as p, i (p.id)}
        <FigureBlock
          class={cn(
            "flex flex-col gap-2",
            (((layout as string) === "masonry") ? "mb-4 break-inside-avoid" : ""),
            ((((layout as string) === "mosaic") && (i === 0)) ? "col-span-2 row-span-2" : ""),
            (((layout as string) === "cards") ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" : "")
          )}
          testid="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame
            alt={p.title}
            ratio={
              (layout as string) === "masonry" ? ((p.size === "tall") ? "3/4" : ((p.size === "wide") ? "16/9" : ((p.size === "large") ? "4/3" : "1/1")))
              : (layout as string) === "grid" ? "4/3"
              : "1/1"
            }
            class={(((layout as string) === "mosaic") ? "h-full" : "")}
          />
          {#if (((captions as string) === "show") && ((layout as string) === "cards"))}
            <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {p.title}
              </Text>
              <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm">
                {p.tag}
              </Badge>
            </Group>
          {/if}
          {#if (((captions as string) === "show") && (((layout as string) === "grid") || ((layout as string) === "masonry")))}
            <Box class="text-sm text-muted-foreground" data-testid="caption">
              {p.title}
            </Box>
          {/if}
        </FigureBlock>
      {/each}
    </Box>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
